_about: Water (1) + acetic acid (2): isobaric T-x-y at 101.33 kPa, binary data set from Chang et al. (2005). Rows as in the ThermoML Archive record: liquid mole fraction of water, boiling temperature in K, vapour mole fraction of water.

source.citation: W. Chang, G. Guan, X. Li, H. Yao, Isobaric Vapor-Liquid Equilibria for Water + Acetic Acid + (n-Pentyl Acetate or Isopropyl Acetate), J. Chem. Eng. Data 50 (2005) 1129-1133
source.access: Journal article is subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 5 (boiling temperature) and 6 (vapour mole fraction): the binary acetic acid + water set. The table number in the article was not checked (article not open).

notes: Expanded uncertainties per point in the ThermoML record: T 0.49 to 0.49 K, y_1 0.0116 to 0.0175. Values as stored in the ThermoML record (XML file), extracted with validation/python/thermoml_read.py; nothing converted or rounded. To be checked by a person against the record before use (AGENTS.md rule 4).
